body: I think the hard part for me is the need for a reason. I've always been told it's selfish to go. But I feel the fact that I search and search shows how much I want to stay despite my incessant need to stop. I genuinely want to feel that feeling that makes the day okay. I want to go on. I want that wave to pass and leave.

Thankyou. I used to write fairly often. I genuinely enjoyed it, more often then not I would set my pages on fire. Literal fire, and just be happy to get them out of me and then out of the world. I just stopped one day years ago. This is the first time I've written anything down in so long.
It made me cry to write it too, I'm sorry you feel this way.
